title: mentha × verticillata var. latissima
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. latissima, commonly known as Bowles' mint, is a hybrid mint plant derived from the cross between Mentha × verticillata and Mentha requienii. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, which include alleviating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Bowles' mint include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and carvone, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
